messages:
maria_g: Noticing reproducible divergence after we flipped int4v2 for aurora-32k. Long prefill traces (>=8k tokens) show a slowly growing phase mismatch vs fp16. Not catastrophic but consistent across runs — looks like RoPE phase wobble. Anyone else hit this on bring-up?

aj_carter: Can you share the quick numbers and a tiny repro? L2/logit delta or KL per-token would help.

maria_g: Sure. L2 logits fp16 vs int4v2: ~0.0016 @1k, ~0.009 @8k, ~0.022 @16k. Repro is in tests/long_prefill_probe.py, run with --model aurora-32k-int4v2 --prefill 16000 --seed 123 --store /tmp/kv.npz.

devon_ml: Any KV dumps? Also pull rot_cos/rot_sin for a few layers to inspect index alignment. My hunch: quantized kernel index arithmetic + compact packing -> phase offsets.

maria_g: Uploaded kv + rotvecs to s3://redwood-dev/kvdumps/2754323456/ (layers 1,8,20).

aj_carter: FYI the runtime has an old optimization 'rotary-wrap-fast' which skips per-block modular reduction; might be enabled in the fast quant path. @eva_infra which flags are enabled on the int4v2 pool?

eva_infra: int4v2 nodes run with flags: --quant-fastpath, --index-stride-opt. We also exposed --rotary-wrap-fix (default off). I'll spin a canary enabling --rotary-wrap-fix to force canonical modulo behavior.

sanjay: Also check KV packer: compacting trailing padding can shift position indices if we don't account for blocked layout. Position offset + per-token rounding could create a growing residual.

maria_g: Ran canary with --rotary-wrap-fix=on: L2 @16k falls to ~0.010 (from 0.022). So fix helps quite a bit. Curious why effect kicks in after ~4k tokens.

devon_ml: That smells like accumulation. Even tiny per-token index corrections accumulate across sequence length. Let's instrument per-token phase_res = mean(abs(rot_fp16 - rot_int4v2)) and plot vs token idx. I'll add hook to the repro.

aj_carter: Also try changing shard layout to contiguous (no compact packing) with --shard-layout=contiguous to isolate packer impact.

maria_g: Running contiguous run now, ETA ~10m.

ci-bot: job #4892 started: long-prefill-probe (triggered by @maria_g). Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/4892

ci-bot: job #4892: step 'dump-kv' finished (14s). artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/4892/kv_dump.npz

maria_g: Contiguous layout result: L2 @16k = 0.012. Better than original but a hair worse than rotary-wrap-fix. So two contributors: wrap index math + packing.

sanjay: Matches expectation: orthogonal factors. Small constant position shifts from packing plus modular remainder mismatch -> larger tail residual.

devon_ml: Plan: 1) add per-token phase residual logging to tests, 2) run git-bisect across quant kernel commits for int4v2, 3) add a regression test asserting phase_residual < 0.006 up to 32k for the canonical Aurora config.

aj_carter: Also run a small QA/bench eval to see if downstream QA accuracy changes materially, not just L2. Maria can you run 100 prompt QA with beam=1/3?

maria_g: Did a quick eval (100 prompts, greedy): F1 drop fp16->int4v2 = -1.1% overall. Top failures correlate with per-token phase_residual > 0.02 near the tail. Uploaded report to the s3 folder.

eva_infra: I'll open infra PR to default --rotary-wrap-fix=true on int4v2 pools and add a baseline perf benchmark to detect regressions. Also exposing a rollout toggle in Dedicated deploy UI.

maria_g: I'll commit a small repro and the phase-residual plots to the repro folder. Devon, can you take the kernel bisect?

devon_ml: Yep, starting bisect across last 6 kernel merges. Expect ~3hrs. Will post any offending commit.

aj_carter: If kernel math is culprit we patch; otherwise we'll coordinate KV packer and wrap-fix. Keep this thread as the canonical triage here.

maria_g: Thanks all. Artifacts in s3://redwood-dev/kvdumps/2754323456/; repro in tests/long_prefill_probe.py. Will update when bisect finishes or PR lands. :thumbsup:
